features: Fix first-load stale price: historical R2/Pionex daily K warm-up now completes before the first TradingView Scanner snapshot is applied.
On initial page load, the monitor immediately requests TradingView PIONEX PERP close/open/high/low after warm-up instead of waiting for the next 10-second timer.
Newly added symbols also warm historical K first and then immediately request current TradingView data.
Watchlist changes synced from another computer now warm new symbols and immediately refresh current prices.
The normal 10-second TradingView Scanner loop remains unchanged after the initial immediate refresh.
